newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close off, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close off, consolidation seen.

text.p: 1320 GMT - Austrian shares close virtually unchanged. Market under pressure from oil and chemicals group OMV, regional electricity company EVN and Creditanstalt. Traders expect further consolidation in line with Wall Street. ATX seen supported at 1,170.
* ATX index down 0.07 points or 0.01 percent at 1,172.87
* February ATX future down 1.5 points at 1,178.5
* Six ATX shares up, 13 down, two unchanged
* KTM the biggest gainer, up 3.93 pct at 688 schillings
* OMV the leading decliner, down 1.51 percent at 1,300 schillings
* Vienna Bourse index up 0.03 points or 0.01 percent at 438.64
